preview: Sarah: Before you go, one thing: back in July you cancelled the NerdQX order and went for the B30 instead. What made you switch?

messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll look that up for you now.

Sorry about the wait on this one, the B30 slipped past its original date. Your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The BSB B30 and the Power K. both ship October 30, 2026, going to (address hidden).

Tracking goes to (email hidden) automatically once the label prints, so worth whitelisting us so it doesn't land in spam.

Anything else I can check for you?

I know. The good news is you were already looked after on this one: the free Power K. on your order was added because of the delay, and the $899 price you paid is locked in.

October 30 is the date for both lines, and tracking comes to your email as soon as it ships.

Yes, and I won't dress it up. You ordered July 20, the date was September 5, and it's now October 30. The manufacturer redesigned the cooling to make the unit quieter, and that pushed the build back.

We wrote to you on September 15 with the batch dates. Your price is locked and the Power K. came free for the wait.

October 30 stands. Do you want to keep waiting on it?
Yes but seems like they should be providing some sort of discount for the delay

That's fair to ask, and it's already been done: the Power K. on your order is free, added specifically for this delay, and you're holding the $899 price while the unit's cost went up. That was our make-good, so I can't stack another one on top of it.

October 30 for both lines, tracking to your email when it ships. Anything else I can sort out for you?
